name: roof_plan
description: Composite-plan roof generator (组合平面屋顶): for L/T/U (and any plan decomposable into <=3 rectangle wings). Reads the SAME plan as plan_shape (same seed = same plan, computed via plan_shape.footprint), splits it into wing strips (equal-x-set z-row runs), roofs each wing with gable_roof (ridge along its long axis — main and wing automatically PERPENDICULAR), main wing wins cell conflicts (subordinate roof dies into the main slope), and lays a 45-degree valley channel (inverted stairs, half=top) from each inner corner up to just below the main ridge. 治'L 形房子盖两个平行双坡'.
when_to_use: Whenever the composition axis / plan is L, T or U: run this INSTEAD of gable_roof per wing. Rect plans: use gable_roof/hip_roof directly. O 围合/cluster: roof each mass/ring segment separately (本卡只管 <=3 翼). seed 必须和墙体的 plan_shape 完全一致, 否则屋面和平面对不上。origin = 平面包围盒西北角, y = 墙顶上一层.

origin.notes: 平面包围盒西北角; y = 屋顶基层

seed.notes: 必须与墙体 plan_shape 同 seed

material.notes: 屋面楼梯材, 按风格卡

ridge_support.notes: 脊下梁材(防半缝悬空, E8 实测)

valley_material.notes: 谷沟材(倒放楼梯); 想用对比色就给别的

pitfalls: seed/shape/width/depth/wing 必须与墙体 plan_shape 完全一致 — 这是同一个平面的两次计算, 不一致屋面就歪
从属翼的脊低于主脊是正确形态, 别手动拉平
谷沟是倒放楼梯(half=top)替换屋面格, 不是架在屋面上; 看到凸起的棱线就是放错了层
翼宽 <=2 时谷沟可能只有 1-2 格, 正常; 平面锯齿/带洞会直接 die(v1 只支持条带矩形)
